frontmatter.name: product-roadmap-maintenance

frontmatter.name: release-readiness
frontmatter.description: Assess or prepare an AngysGuard / Laptop Guard release using Graphify impact/freshness, CI, tests, changelog, roadmap, security status, platform/control-mode support, version metadata, repository presentation, and target-device checks.

frontmatter.name: safe-implementation
frontmatter.description: Implement or modify Laptop Guard runtime behavior while preserving authorization, privacy, configuration, architecture, and repository-presentation boundaries. Use for features, fixes, refactors, CLI/setup behavior, providers, hardware integrations, or service changes.

frontmatter.name: security-review
frontmatter.description: Review Laptop Guard changes for authorization bypasses, secret leakage, command/path injection, unsafe capture, insecure defaults, and remote-control abuse. Use for security-sensitive changes or before releases.

frontmatter.name: test-and-verify
frontmatter.description: Select and run Laptop Guard verification after code or configuration changes. Use when validating a fix/feature, diagnosing failures, preparing a PR, or deciding whether work is complete.
